links.outcome: Clinical deterioration events and 21-day mortality with vs without AI risk trajectory display
links.effect: No change in primary outcome between groups; more event-free hours in display-on group among those with events but not statistically significant; 11% of patients transferred into or out of display beds.
links.quote: Predictive analytics monitoring incorporating continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring and displays of risk trajectories coupled with an education plan did not improve patient outcomes or reduce deaths.

unlisted_practices: Passive display of AI risk score trajectories with no mandated response, paired with an education plan

screen.reason: Pragmatic randomized controlled trial assessing the clinical impact of deploying a predictive analytics deterioration risk display in a hospital cardiology ward.

primary.practice: passive display of risk trajectories with staff education
